# Samuel Burke

> Full-stack engineer and founder of Burke Systems, a small software studio in Raleigh-Durham, NC. Builds the scheduling, tracking and internal tools that small teams run their day on.

## Work

- [ShiftView](https://shiftview.app): Scheduling and a time clock for retail and fulfillment teams. Built solo with Next.js 16, React 19, Supabase and TypeScript. Deterministic auto-scheduler, real-time coverage, two-layer security (API route handlers plus row-level security), 1,600+ automated tests. Source: https://github.com/samuel-burke/shiftview
- [samuelburke.dev](https://github.com/samuel-burke/samuel-burke-dev): This site. Built with coding agents against a written design spec (DESIGN.md), statically exported to Cloudflare Pages.
